notes.title: [PATCH v.0.8.2] Early Access patch 2
notes.notes:
So, here's the second patch for the World Soccer Strikers '91 Early Access!

This small update has focused on making the input system more robust and reliable. Here are the changes:

Changes

A different song will play when a match ends with a draw and we go for a Golden Goal tie-breaker.
Team physical stat affects slightly more to player movement.
Much robust input handling. Improved keyboard / gamepad compatibility and made input reassignment much more reliable when a connection is lost.


Fixes

Bug in ended leagues, where the user would be allowed to replay the last fixture of the league after it is over.


And that's it! As always, thanks for playing!

The Dev Team

notes.title: [PATCH v.0.8.1] Early Access "Day One" patch
notes.notes:
Patch v.0.8.1

World Soccer Strikers '91 is finally out!

During the first day of the game on Steam, we've been hearing suggestions and bug reports from our community, resulting in the following changes in the game:

Additions

When playing single-player and the "auto-change players" option is on, any CPU-controlled character that touches the ball will automatically switch input and become user-controlled. There will be no auto-switching for AI first-touch passes and shots.
Skip credits when pressing 'Esc' or cancel button.
Extra-large player marker option in the settings menu, which doubles the size of the overhead player icon.


Changes

Added a small delay when team logos appear after a goal is scored.


Fixes

Error which may freeze the game while saving a goal replay, leaving the progress at 0.00%.
Fixed bug where the achievements "It's called football" and "It's called soccer" would not trigger.


Known issues

Steam Remote Play Together doesn't detect gamepad input.


And that is all for now! We'll keep working on the game and hearing any suggestion you guys may have!

Thanks for playing, and stay safe,
The Dev Team

notes.title: Release delayed a few days
notes.notes:
Hi guys, 

So yeah, unfortunately we’ve got some not-ideal news. We’ll have to delay WSS91 release a few days. We’ve found a couple of issues in our latest build that we need to correct before we can launch the World Soccer Strikers’91 Early Access. They're related to playing the game 8-player on multiplayer and using the Play Together online option.

We know that this is not great to hear, but hey, at least it's not Cyberpunk getting delayed this time around! While we solve these issues you guys can continue giving us more teams suggestions and trying out the demo!  

We will be also prolonging the Steam-key give away until WSS91 launches its Early Access, so head over to our Twitter page and follow the instructions!

Well, that is the news for now! We’ll keep you guys posted with the latest news everywhere you can. Again, we are sorry for the delay! 

Bests wishes and have a fun weekend,

- Meteorbyte Publishing ++ & Bipolar Dawn

PS: Remember that you can still play the demo for free! Check out the game if you haven't yet.
